question: What oblation substance and context are prescribed for the ritual offering?
premises: Milk-rice is the prescribed offering substance.
The offering is made when worship has been performed.
The oblation is directed into the golden seed.
inference: One should offer milk-rice into the golden seed after worship.
uncertainties: hema+retasi may refer to fire or another ritual receptacle.
plain_english: One should offer milk-rice into the golden seed when worship has been performed.
